principle: A user who grants screen access must not automatically grant command execution. Every permission is evaluated independently by the server-side Policy Engine.

view_only.description: Live desktop streaming with zero input or execution permissions.

human_control.description: Human operator controls mouse and keyboard directly. AI input is suppressed.

ai_assisted.description: AI operates approved computer-use tools while the human watches live and can take over immediately.

ai_permissions.open_application: policy.desktop_enabled and app in policy.allowed_apps and not session.human_takeover_active
ai_permissions.execute_commands: policy.allow_shell and command in policy.allowed_commands and not session.human_takeover_active
